archimate:ArchimateModel.name: HE digital roadmap
archimate:ArchimateModel.purpose: The development of an overarching Digital strategy, underpinned by a technology strategy (including strategic architecture), which will inform and support the creation of a subsequent business case. All work must be completed and invoiced prior to the end of March 2026. The strategy will be required to review current state architecture, understand the desired end-state and articulate via a 3-year phased approach to achieving that.
